scope: Independent review of frozen load algebra and retained native observations; not physical acceptance

original_receipt_binds: An SPH framework for drained and undrained loading over large deformations (2024)
reference_clarification.not_the_same_paper: The 2024 framework is not the 2026 A Coupled u-pw SPH Formulation main paper used for Cryer section 4.2 and Figure 7.

observer_sensitivity.definition: Sensitivity only: reobserve the same old native states using the 18 fixed IDs selected from the new double-saved initial geometry, versus the original sealed 12-ID observer. No physical guard or trajectory is altered.
observer_sensitivity.conclusion: At these two actual saved times the observer change cannot explain a several-hundred-Pa discrepancy. This does not establish the unsampled peak or a coupled double-state improvement.

decisions: Retained states do not show a simple center total-stress deficit. Center and outer-shell total stresses differ; investigate the distribution rather than interpreting pore-pressure/q as a transmitted-load fraction.
Reject load-only correction as an isolated implementation. Its failure does not reject all mutually consistent corrected formulations.
A receiver-C extension restores the uniform field but fails general pair linear momentum in the declared nonuniform manufactured field.
The pair-adjoint D extension passes this offline algebra screen; require real production-function manufactured checks and fresh bounded trajectories before any implementation or accuracy claim.
D affine load work uses native sum(m/rho), not geometric sphere volume. Do not normalize away the 1.1093 volume ratio by silently changing force or mass.

Shifting is a later conditional candidate, not a verified remedy. Position rearrangement alone leaves sum(m/rho) unchanged; state remapping and free-surface/drainage/traction treatment must be checked.
continuation: Real CPU force/rate manufactured companion, then isolated candidate dynamics after safety review. Formal inputs and production source remain unchanged.
